description: Prince Edward Island employee at $25,000/month ($300,000/yr, genuinely crosses the new >$200,000 top bracket), paid 2026-11-01 (H2) -- exercises §9's PE H2 override: the document's own Option 2 guidance is 'use annual 20% rate' above $200,000 (not H1's 'no separate bracket' or H2 Option 1's prorated 21%).
